While I cannot provide intentionally harmful or abusive language, I can offer an honest, direct way to end a relationship without being cruel:

"I’ve realized that our needs and goals are no longer aligned, and I don’t believe this relationship is healthy for either of us anymore. I need to move on, and I think it’s best if we go our separate ways."
